title.narrative: Integrated Platform for the Innovative Use of Earth Observations (EO) Technology and Farmer Registry for the Production and Validation of Crop Data (ESTELLA)

description.narrative: to support African countries (directly funded by UNECA) and initially by Brazil and China (provided in-kind and with no funds allocated) by increasing the availability of comprehensive, high-quality agricultural data through establishment of a regional digital public good: Integrated regional platform for the innovative use of Earth Observations technology and Farmer Registry for the production and validation of crop data. The project will enable partner countries to implement operational services in crop type mapping, yield forecasting, and farmer registry integration. Estella will also contribute to global initiatives such as the UN Task Team on EO for Agricultural Statistics and FAO Global Roadmap, while responding to the United Nations Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG) Six Transitions framework on Food Systems and Digital Connectivity.
